result.rationale: The requested Northern Virginia label and the existing canonical QSP refer to the same manager-level investment. Wren House's portfolio materials identify QSP as the 2024 three-facility Northern Virginia data-center joint venture. BlackRock is the evidenced co-investor. QTS retained an operating/minority role and remains Blackstone-backed upstream, but Blackstone should not be conflated with the direct JV co-investor. Task 491 is therefore covered by this decision.

identityResolution.recordBoundary: One manager-level investment only; do not separately count holdcos, financing entities or individual campuses.

operatingResolution.assetBoundary: Single portfolio of three completed Northern Virginia data centers; do not separately list campuses or SPVs.
operatingResolution.ownedCapacity: Approximately 100 MW; financing evidence reports 99.6 MW across the three-facility portfolio.
operatingResolution.plannedCapacity: Exclude broader QTS development pipeline unless directly attributed to QSP.

acquisitionExitCheck.financing: Portfolio financing aligns with the same three-facility 99.6 MW portfolio and is not a separate equity investment.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterSearch: No evidenced transfer, recapitalization, exit or signed pending equity transaction through 2026-08-19.

milestones.event: Financing materials describe the three-facility 99.6 MW Northern Virginia portfolio.
Wren House announced completion of the QSP joint venture.
Current searches found no subsequent ownership change; QSP remains active.

beforeAfterChanges.before: Requested Northern Virginia JV label and canonical QSP potentially treated separately.
beforeAfterChanges.after: Use one canonical QSP record covering this request and later task 491; distinguish BlackRock as co-investor and QTS/Blackstone as retained operator/upstream sponsor.

unresolvedQuestions: Undisclosed ownership percentages other than Wren House's disclosed 40%
result.recommendedListAction: Merge the requested Northern Virginia label into canonical QSP; retain a single active manager-level record and keep all campuses, holdcos and financing entities beneath it.
